mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_data_source (name, db_type, host, port, database_name, username, password, remark, create_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{dbType}, #{host}, #{port}, #{databaseName}, #{username}, #{password}, #{remark}, #{createBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_data_source SET name = #{name}, db_type = #{dbType}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, database_name = #{databaseName}, username = #{username}, password = #{password}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, db_type, host, port, database_name, username, password, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM ai_data_source ORDER BY id DESC
